## Summary

What does this change and why?

## How was it tested?

- [ ] API: `ruff check`, `mypy`, `pytest`
- [ ] Web: `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm build`, and E2E where relevant
- [ ] Extension tests, if the extension changed
- [ ] Screenshots for visible UI changes (light and dark)

## Checklist

- [ ] Works with public content only; no bypass of DRM, logins, paywalls or other access controls
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, personal data or generated media committed
- [ ] Limits, SSRF protection, CSP and security headers are not weakened
- [ ] User-facing errors stay honest (no fake success or placeholder downloads)
- [ ] Documentation updated if behaviour or configuration changed
